title: Mean Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for the mean energy, <E> = (hbar omega / 2) coth(hbar omega / (2 k T)).

title: Fluctuation Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for the root-mean-square fluctuation in energy, Delta E = (hbar omega / (2 sinh(hbar omega / (2 k T)))).

title: Low Temperature Behavior
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly describe the behavior of <E> and Delta E in the limit kT << hbar omega.

title: High Temperature Behavior
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly describe the behavior of <E> and Delta E in the limit kT >> hbar omega.

title: Partition Function Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show understanding of the partition function and its role in deriving <E>.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all expressions have consistent units throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the expressions for <E> and Delta E.
